top_signals.title: Iranian Floating Crude Storage Drops to Under 4 Million Barrels
top_signals.summary: Iran’s floating crude storage in Asia is nearly gone. Windward put Iranian crude stored on tankers off Malaysia at about 70 million barrels in January, and at most about 3.8 million barrels remain. The tankers that delivered that crude are sitting empty off Sri Lanka.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump sealed deal for Nvidia to rehire Jensen Huang as CEO
top_signals.summary: President Trump said his administration gave Nvidia's board assurance that Jensen Huang would not be a national security threat if he was reinstated as CEO.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: ‘This establishes a bottom’: Jensen Huang’s return seen as likely to stop market sell-off, for now
top_signals.summary: Wall Street strategists say Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia could steady the AI trade, though spending and data-center risks remain.
